//: Merged into .claude/settings.json by /orchestrator-init, each part only with the owner's OK. Keys starting with // are notes and are not copied.
//permissions: Deny reads of build output: they are large and never the source of truth. Keep only the folders this project has. Agent(Plan) denies the built-in planning subagent, whose exploration /write-plan already does in the main session.
//promptCacheTtl: Keeps the main session's prompt cache for an hour, so an orchestrator waiting on a 10-minute stage does not rewrite its context. Only if this Claude Code version knows the key; subagents stay on 5 minutes (ledger I1).
//hooks: Only for checkouts with CRLF line endings (Windows, core.autocrlf): Write saves LF, so overwriting a CRLF file with Write changes every line. The hook refuses it and asks for Edit. Needs Node.
